QUOTE: An unknown top-level section name is refused by name, so a misspelled section fails the build instead of quietly running on defaults.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says unknown sections are refused by name rather than ignored, with the reason that a misspelling would otherwise quietly build on defaults. It does not mention the "allowed set" or the "reports the declaration was honoured" part, but it covers the mechanism and the reason.
